name: Seize the Momentum
desc:
If at least 3 %s-type Pokemon are initially deployed, Control Rate increases by 25%% and damage dealt to targets affected by abnormal effects increases by 25%%; with 5 such Pokemon, before each major round starts there is a 30%% chance to inflict 1 random target with one of Stun, Sleep, Freeze, Silence, or Confusion for 1 round
Monster traits in this season's stages (scale up with stage progression):
#L00000010#Control Immunity#L00000000#: Control Immunity increases
#L00000010#Mutation#L00000000#: When not under control effects, Damage Reduction increases, and actions deal true damage to the main target based on dual ATK
#L00000010#Fight On#L00000000#: After each active attack, damage dealt increases for 2 rounds (stackable, cleared when controlled)
#L00000010#Last Stand#L00000000#: Crit Rate and Crit Damage increase, but this effect is disabled for 2 rounds while under control effects
